audit.summary: Strip cutoff depends on scaling matrix and leaves an admissible geodesic wholly untruncated, invalidating literal regularisation used in the continuous-spectrum proof. Main conclusions not disproved.
limitations: Counterevidence: Full-horoball correction yields paired finite cutoff; in example integral identically0 by modular symmetry.
Limitations: No counterexample to main equidistribution conclusions.
Limitations: General repaired regularisation and downstream identities not completely verified.
Limitations: External analytic results and all moment extensions not independently proved.
Limitations: Two unresolved normalization/injectivity concerns excluded from confirmed findings.
Limitations: Native auxiliary limited to provided algebra, no full paper reading/acceptance.

Counterevidence: Full horoballs restore scaling independence. On the same example the remaining segment i/Y to iY has integral zero by modular inversion. A quotient interpretation requires complete lifts; it is not the defined strip cutoff. This does not prove that intended regularization or equidistribution is impossible.
Limitations: No writes, build, readiness decision, author-code execution, claimed human review or independently verified backend identity.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.
